citations.claim: before collision, controller force at limit, no touching
first violating step, body 0 now touching body 1, controller force 163.22 exceeds 59.983

counterfactual.change: Increased controller fmax from 59.983 to 200.0 – with higher limit the same collision at step 60 no longer exceeds limit, proving force capping is bypassed during collision.

explanation: At step 59 body 0 is free, controller_force is exactly at fmax (59.983). At step 60 body 0 collides with body 1 (touching_pairs gap ~0.0003). In that same step controller_force jumps to 163.22 > fmax 59.983. The collision impulse/velocity change occurs within substeps (15 substeps) and the controller's proportional law produces a large force that is not clamped to fmax during/after collision resolution. Raising fmax to 200 eliminates the violation, confirming force limiting is bypassed during collisions.
vision_note: From steps 57 to 59 the red controller-driven body edges toward the green waypoint while in near-contact with a blue body. At step 60 the red and blue bodies collide/touch, which is the reported moment of the controller_force_limit violation.
